speaker: A3976SWQ9TVFVN
text: Hi how are you doing?

speaker: A294A6GI34E9OI
text: Great! How are you?

speaker: A3976SWQ9TVFVN
text: I am doing well. Thank you for asking. I have a question, have you ever donated to a charity?

speaker: A294A6GI34E9OI
text: Yes I have. My mother -in-law had breast cancer so I donate to Cancer Research

speaker: A3976SWQ9TVFVN
text: Cancer research is very important. We are talking with people today about Save the Children. It's a charity, have you heard of it?

speaker: A294A6GI34E9OI
text: No I haven't. Tell me about it.

speaker: A3976SWQ9TVFVN
text: Save the Children is a global charity. It is beneficial by providing children with a variety of necessities such a clothing, food, shelter, clean water. The charity focuses primarily on third world countries, but has been known to help children in United States.

speaker: A294A6GI34E9OI
text: Ok, yes, that is very important.

speaker: A3976SWQ9TVFVN
text: It truly is. Our children need to be taken care of, and due to lack of resources in third world countries, children are suffering. It is disheartening to see and hear about.

speaker: A294A6GI34E9OI
text: Yes, it is very hard to look at pictures of children in raggety clothes and they look so thin.

speaker: A3976SWQ9TVFVN
text: I agree. Sadly, the world as a whole don't view this as a global problem. Not to be cliche, but children are our future, and it's our moral obligation to make sure they are taken care of and given the proper resources to prosper and thrive in this world. Do you agree?

speaker: A294A6GI34E9OI
text: Yes I would agree with that statement.

speaker: A3976SWQ9TVFVN
text: Sadly, many people would not. Would you be willing to make a donation to Save the Children's charity today from 0.1 cents to $2?

speaker: A294A6GI34E9OI
text: Not at this time but I do appreciate the information you have given me today!

speaker: A3976SWQ9TVFVN
text: May I ask why?

speaker: A294A6GI34E9OI
text: I have a friend who works overseas in an orphanage. She asks for support and I give directly to her. She sends me pictures of what she does with my money and it's clothing those kids and giving them their basic needs.

speaker: A3976SWQ9TVFVN
text: I understand. Having a visual of what's being done is very important. However, we have children that are suffering, and even just a penny can make a difference in their lives. Are you sure you couldn't spare one penny? Our website is  URL if you wanted to gather more information

speaker: A294A6GI34E9OI
text: Not at this time. I am maxed out with giving at this point. If I get a raise at my job then I'd think about it.

speaker: A3976SWQ9TVFVN
text: I understand that financial restraints can deter us from giving, but these children are dependent on us. They need not only our love, but support. One penny won't break the bank, and you'll know that that one cent, so minute to us, is so rich to them as it provide basic necessities for them to live.

speaker: A294A6GI34E9OI
text: Well, like I said I can't give any more at this point. I do what I can and I feel that I cannot give anymore at this time.
